standard_fields.uw_rationale:
1. The export data should include the NAICS code from the “exposure details” tab as this is required for our “homework”. Any chance we can add that data into that export?
  2. When Excess is selected, one more column should be added to the table screenshot below. I could be labeled “Notes”. This should be an open text field where we can put a very brief comments as to why we used the selected factor. This is required for our admitted compliance on excess. Using the below screenshot as an example, I would add in a comment next to industry sector factor (“competitive environment for data centers”) and for the company factor (“acquisition history could lead to some downside”).
  3. The ideal state would be for the “generate coverage options” button to prompt an Outlook email with the attachment locked and loaded to send. Not sure if that is feasible within the HX platform.
  4. Also, the formatting of the rationale section sems to be a bit wonky. I tried to paste the data as plain text into HX, but it did not help.
